what.text: This page follows refugees from Eritrea living in the United Kingdom, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 31172 Eritrean refugees in the United Kingdom, 5.6% of all refugees from Eritrea.
Ethiopia and Sudan host the most Eritrean refugees, followed by Germany and Switzerland.

why.text: UCDP records an interstate armed conflict between Eritrea and Ethiopia from 1998 to 2000, reaching war level, and again in 2016.
It also records armed conflict over the government of Eritrea in 1997, 1999 and 2003, with EIJM - AS as the opposition group in 1999 and 2003.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2002 at 975 refugees.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2022 to 2025, and the figure is at its highest at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in the United Kingdom.
These are year-end totals for the United Kingdom only, reported to UNHCR.
